journey.name: Edit style profile
journey.description: Opens Settings and reaches the Your-Profile sheet, verifying its chip groups and save action. Start state: fresh install with an unset profile.

actions.action: Tap the "SETTINGS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Settings screen shows a "Your Profile" row with the subtitle "Tap to set up".
Verify the "Your Profile" sheet is shown with a "Body Type" chip group and a "Style Profile" chip group.
Tap the "Athletic" chip in the Body Type group.
Verify a "Save" button is present in the sheet.
